_comment: Short links on go.diginode.tools: "name": "https://where-it-goes". Names are lower case words (letters, numbers and hyphens), and must contain a vowel - so they can never clash with a DigiFact's four-character short link (e.g. 7ttm), which never has one. Change where a link goes at any time: every DigiNode that uses it follows straight away.
